derivation:
by
  simpa only [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_inv, SpecialLinearGroup.det_coe, one_smul] using
    Matrix.adjugate_mul (coefficientRowCompletionTwo R a b h : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R)
explanation: Instantiate the adjugate identity at the completion matrix. Its determinant is one, and its special-linear inverse is definitionally its adjugate. The current proof instead uses group cancellation.
